$doc: Uniform fleet execution profile for the long P1LR decision run. It changes no experimental factor: every seed receives the same replay capacity. The base 200000-transition buffer advertises 21.80 GB per worker for this observation space, while Gamma runs two workers with about 15 GB physical RAM. The bounded profile retains two complete 20000-step pass-equivalents and prevents a known OOM configuration from masquerading as unattended execution. Replay capacity remains a future optimization parameter.
